email_subject: Application - Content Strategist: SEO, AI & Digital Growth
email_body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I noticed MediaMarktSaturn is looking for a Content Strategist to coordinate, create and optimise digital content with a focus on AI-driven improvements. That's exactly the work I do: at Episto I run keyword research, technical SEO and link building for client businesses, and I've built ~600 member profile pages on one consistent layout for a pharmacists' association. I also use AI daily in my own products and in an AI job-search assistant I built, so I understand how to turn AI insights into concrete content actions.

I live in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and have my own car, so the daily trip to your Strombeek-Bever office is no problem. I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level.

In the first weeks I'd audit your content calendar and SEO performance, then propose AI-assisted improvements to your copywriting workflow. I'd welcome a conversation about how I can help.

Baver Ok

As a freelancer I sell AI search visibility and SEO, build landing pages and present results to client teams. I built kxp.be single-handedly in WordPress with on-page SEO and GEO for AI search in three languages. I track performance in GA4, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs and turn insights into concrete actions. I am analytical, follow algorithm updates closely and am eager to learn.
